ix:TemplateColumn.Caption: PPAP Due Date
ix:TemplateColumn.template: <div class="<%# Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate").ToString() != "" ? (DateTime) Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate") < DateTime.Today ? "redDiv" : (DateTime) Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate") <= DateTime.Today.AddDays(Convert.ToInt32(Container.ViewData.Eval("PPAPCautioInd"))) ? "yellowDiv" : (DateTime) Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate") > DateTime.Today.AddDays(Convert.ToInt32(Container.ViewData.Eval("PPAPCautioInd"))) ?"greenDiv" : "" : "inlineDiv" %>"><%# Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate").ToString() != "" ? String.Format("{0:MM/dd/yyyy}", Container.ViewData.Eval("SubmissionDate")) : "-- Assign Due Date --"%>
